text: Alla Daalani Annabiijo Makko on Muusaa : "Pellet, Alla Harminii e ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen, naatugol ndii leydi laɓɓinaandi, dumunna duuɓi cappanɗe nayi, e nder on dumunna, ɓe luttay e majjugol ka jeeree- nde ton. Wata a suno, an Muusaa, e ɓen yimɓe yaltuɓe e ɗoftaare Alla, sabu geddi maɓɓe ɗin e junubaaji maɓɓe ɗin lepti ɓe.
